subject: Quick check: missed demo & shifting priorities this quarter
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@storify.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduled demo — Sep 14 10:00 PT / Agenda attached

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking time to talk with us. This is a quick note to lock in our demo on Tuesday, Sep 14 at 10:00 AM PT (30 minutes). I attached a short agenda so we can focus on the parts that matter most to Starlit.

Agenda (attached: agenda_v1.pdf):
- 5m intros + goals
- 10m live demo: latency/cost controls and routing policies
- 10m Q&A and next steps
- 5m optional: procurement/contract cadence

If anything changes on your side, let me know — happy to move. Otherwise I’ll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 24KB)

From: Elena Park <elena@storify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled demo — Sep 14 10:00 PT / Agenda attached

Hi Ben,

Really sorry — last-minute travel for our head of product came up and we had to pull Tom out of the office. We missed the call.

Priority update: leadership reprioritized a launch window, so the evaluation scope has narrowed to two parts: (1) short proof-of-concept for routing/cost controls, and (2) a focused integration check with our data retention policy. I don’t want to waste your time if our internal priorities mean we shift the timeline.

Can we pause for a week while I confirm with Tom and procurement? If it still makes sense, I can propose new slots next week.

Apologies again for the no-show — totally our fault.

Best,
Elena
Director of Product | Starlit Design
elena@storify.ai

--
Attachment: starlit_eval_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 68KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@storify.ai>, Tom Walker <tom.walker@starlit.design>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T14:53:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled demo — quick follow on next steps and short scoping option

Hi Elena (and Tom),

No worries — thanks for the heads up, and I appreciate the context on the priority shift. Two quick options to make this easy on your side:

1) Short scoping call (20 minutes) — we do a tight walkthrough focused only on routing/cost controls and list a 2–3 item technical checklist for your team. This is useful if procurement wants minimal artifacts to keep the project open.
2) Pause and reconvene — I can check back in two weeks; we’ll keep the HubSpot deal open and I’ll send a calendar poll when you’re ready.

If option 1 is interesting, suggested times next week (all PT):
- Tue Sep 21, 9:30–9:50
- Wed Sep 22, 11:00–11:20
- Thu Sep 23, 16:00–16:20

I also created a quick availability poll: https://cal.example.com/poll/starlit-demo-availability — feel free to pick a slot. I’ll keep this thread short.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/SD-2026-09-B1 (I’ve added the notes from today).

If you prefer to pause, I’ll check back on Sep 28.

Thanks — and again, no problem on the calendar. We know things move fast during launches.

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Elena Park <elena@storify.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Walker <tom.walker@starlit.design>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduled demo — quick follow on next steps and short scoping option

Hi Ben,

Thanks — option 1 sounds good. We’d like a 20-minute scoping call to keep the evaluation alive without pulling too many folks. Tom and I can do Tue Sep 28 or Tue Oct 5; preference is Sep 28 morning PT.

Can you send a 20-min invite for Sep 28 at 9:30 AM PT (Google Meet)? If anything changes I’ll update the poll, but that should work. Also, any pre-read you want us to look at before the call would be helpful — the evaluation template I attached earlier is our standard intake form.

Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Elena
